verdict.rationale: Bland provides triggers that watch for events and autonomously act (e.g., placing calls) without human intervention, plus batch call campaigns and background polling/webhook flows that run without live supervision. This is solid first-party evidence of autonomous background automation, but there's no documentation of scheduled/cron-based recurring automations or independent corroboration of trigger reliability in production. Missing for 10: scheduling/cron automation docs, independent/hands-on validation of trigger-based automations running unattended long-term.
